dataset: MIMIC-III multitask benchmark (Harutyunyan et al., Scientific Data 2019)
description: 17 clinical time-series variables split across 3 feature-disjoint sites. task_sigma is omitted so create_task calibrates it from dp_epsilon.

body.dataset_id: <uuid of the FAIRDatabase dataset backing this task>

task_creation.task_notes: task_types order is [IHM, Decompensation, LOS, Phenotyping-25] — in-hospital mortality (binary), decompensation (binary), length-of-stay (regression), 25-label phenotype classification (multilabel_25).

hashed_ids: <sha256(subject_id) for each patient this site holds>

psi_submission_example.note: Every site submits this once; PSI must reach 'aligned' before submit_embeddings will accept a round.

simulation_equivalent.note: For the in-process /vfl/tasks/<id>/simulate demo (no real parties/PSI), pass feature_groups matching the same 7/3/7 split via model_arch.feature_groups so dirichlet_feature_partition slices synthetic columns identically to the real party layout above.
